newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: SOCCER-PENPIX OF ASIAN CUP FINALISTS SAUDI ARABIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PENPIX OF ASIAN CUP FINALISTS SAUDI ARABIA.

text.p: Following are penpix of Saudi Arabia's players most likely to play against the United Arab Emirates in the Asian Cup final on Saturday:
Mohammed Al Daeyea (1): A 24-year-old goalkeeper with 74 caps. He was one of the Saudi stars in the 1994 World Cup and is currently in good form. Club: Al-Tae.
Mohammed Al Jahani (2): Defender, 21, who has 48 caps. He has not yet scored for his country. Club: Al-Ahli.
Mohammed Al-Khilaiwi (3): Defender, 25, has played 71 times for his country scoring one goal. Club: Al-Ittihad.
Abdullah Zubromawi (4): A solid 23-year-old defender who has 64 caps and four goals to his name. A key element in Saudi Asian Cup success. Club: Al-Ahli.

Ahmed Madani (5): Defender. At only 26, he is one of the most experienced players with 123 caps in which he scored five goals. Recovered from a leg injury sustained early in the tournament. Club: Al-Ittihad.
Hussain Sulaimani (13): The 19-year-old defender is one of the youngest players in the championship. Highly rate by his coach, he has played 21 times, scoring one goal. Club: Al-Ahli.
Khalid Al Timawi (8): Midfielder, 27, who has 29 caps. Scored twice in the tournament, doubling his tally for country to four. Club: Al-Hilal.
Ibrahim Al Harbi (12): A 21-year-old midfielder who played for country 28 times without scoring. Club: Al-Nassr.
Khalid Al-Muwalid (14): Midfielder, 25, with 73 caps. He is one of the most gifted Saudi players and is the team's playmaker. Scored once in tournament to bring total to 14. Club: Al-Ahli.
Yousif Al Thunai (15): Midfielder, 33, who has 85 caps with amazing 43 goals. Scored twice after coming on as substitute to turn around Saudi quarter-final tie with China. Club: Al-Hilal.
Khamis Al Dossary (16): Midfielder, 23, who has 28 caps and yet to score. Club: Al Hilal.
Sami Al Jaber (9): Striker, 24, who has played 68 times for Saudi Arabia. Scored two goals in tournament, taking goal tally to 17. Club: Al-Hilal.
Fahad Al Mahalel (10): 26-year-old striker who played 69 times for country scoring 17 times. He is Saudi Arabia's leading goalscorer at the UAE with four goals. Club: Al-Shabab.
